properties.headline: Gale Watch issued October 14 at 3:24PM CDT until October 17 at 1:00AM CDT by NWS Chicago IL
properties.description:
* WHAT...For the Small Craft Advisory, significant waves to 6 ft
occasionally to 8 ft expected. For the Gale Watch, north gales
to 40 kt and significant waves to 12 ft occasionally to 16 ft
possible.

* WHERE...Wilmette Harbor to Northerly Island IL.

* WHEN...For the Small Craft Advisory, until 10 AM CDT Thursday.
For the Gale Watch, from Friday afternoon through late Friday
night.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds can cause hazardous waves which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
properties.instruction:
Mariners should consider altering plans to avoid possible
hazardous conditions.  Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter
course, and/or secure the vessel for severe wind and waves.
